purpose: Rebuild the project development pipeline (expanding annual walk-forward with the frozen walk-forward-v1 recipes) from the relabelled table of config/relabel-v1.json, so that the adopted operating point config/operating-point-v3.json rests on a pipeline that is reproducible from source table, protocol and code hashes alone. Fits are the recipes of config/walk-forward-v1.json unchanged; the only differences are the source table and the thresholds written beside each model.

watch.rule: helio24.calibration.recall_threshold on the prior relabelled calibration year

alert.rule: helio24.two_tier.precision_threshold on the prior relabelled calibration year; best-precision threshold and fallback flag when the target is unreachable

comparison_recall_0.95.rule: helio24.calibration.recall_threshold at 0.95, kept visible for comparison with earlier work as config/operating-point-v2.json requires

checks: Per evaluation year, the calibrated ensemble probability of every evaluation window equals the stored relabelled_models column of the relabelled walk-forward predictions, bit for bit (np.array_equal); a non-identical year fails the rebuild.
Per evaluation year, the recall-0.95 and recall-0.90 thresholds equal the stored relabelled_models thresholds.
Per evaluation year, the alert threshold, its calibration recall and precision and its fallback flag equal the stored alert_0.5 entry of the relabelled two-tier thresholds.
Per evaluation year and tier, tp, fp, fn, tn, positive_runs and missed_positive_runs equal the relabelled two-tier results.

frozen_label_reference.rule: Copied beside each year and tier as the frozen-label reference; different window sets, no pooling.

outputs: <year>/models.joblib (models, calibrators, thresholds of all three tiers, features, ensemble weights), <year>/thresholds.json, <year>/predictions.parquet (metadata, logistic, xgboost, ensemble, baseline, alarm flags per tier), <year>/split.json, metrics.csv, reproduction.csv, report.json with reading
order_of_operations: Per year, all thresholds are selected on the prior relabelled calibration year and written to disk before any evaluation label is read.
policy: Expanding training, previous calendar year calibration, next year evaluation (helio24.walk_forward.annual_fold). Skip folds lacking both classes in training or calibration or with no evaluable positives. No model selection or threshold retuning on evaluation years.

reading.pipeline_reproduced: every check of must_reproduce holds in every evaluated year
reading.years_meeting_alert_target: alert tier delivers evaluation-year precision >= 0.50 and is not a fallback year
reading.adoption_effective: pipeline_reproduced holds; the operating point becomes the development basis regardless of the number of years meeting the alert target, which is reported, not required

scope: Development pipeline on already inspected years. Not an independent test, not a performance improvement and not a dashboard or deployed-alert change; app.py and any deployed alert threshold are unchanged. The relabelled labels are an association by NOAA SGAS and JSOC NOAA_ARS, not ground truth.
prohibitions: No change to recipes, seeds, weights, targets or floors
No dashboard, app.py or deployed alert change
